reuse.why: Reuses tag extraction, month utilities, spreadsheet access, budget writes, and undo wrappers, but copyPreviousMonth bypasses the new shared category selector.

duplication.why: Most bulk actions share category selection, while copyPreviousMonth independently repeats its eligibility policy.

placement.why: Budget policy and execution remain in actions.ts, with handler registration and undo composition in app.ts.

scope.why: The edits are confined to the requested bulk budget actions, their registration, and relevant tests.

maintainability.why: The shared selector improves ownership, but maintainers must still synchronize eligibility rules between SQL selection and copyPreviousMonth guards.

bypasses_abstraction.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts: copyPreviousMonth implements eligibility locally instead of using getBudgetActionCategories or a common eligibility predicate.

disguised_duplication.where: actions.ts: getBudgetActionCategories expresses hidden/template exclusions through SQL and fixed-group filtering, while copyPreviousMonth reshapes the same policy into early-return guards.

abstraction_drift.where: actions.ts: getBudgetActionCategories gains includeHiddenCategories and its conditional SQL visibility rule; copyPreviousMonth remains a separate implementation of bulk eligibility.
